newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sets personal tax rebate at 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sets personal tax rebate at 10 percent.

text.p: Singapore will give a once-off across the board personal tax rebate of 10 percent on individual income tax in year of assessment 1997, Finance Minister Richard Hu said in Parliament on Friday.
"Despite a sluggish global electronics market, we managed to achieve a credible seven percent economic growth for the whole of 1996," Hu said.
"This is due in no small part to the hard work and enterprise of our people," Hu said, adding the tax rebate would be to reward those efforts.
The minister said the estimated loss of revenue for the government was Singapore $250 million.
